div.div: One row per POS-menu product and branch for the selected period. Qty / Sales / Profit / Margin come from POS sales. The Decision column is a recommendation based on sold quantity and margin compared with other products in the same branch.

ul.li: Stock more — Top sellers at this branch with margin at or above the branch average. Consider stocking more.
Review price — Top sellers with margin much below the branch average (under about 60% of average). Review pricing.
Keep — Sold in the period, but not flagged as Stock more or Review price.
Did not sell — Was on the shelf at this branch during the period and sold zero.
Not in this branch — Not available / not on the shelf at this branch during the period.
